metaDescription: Result of one submission to the {slug} evaluation task.

failure.title: This file was not scored
failure.quotaConsumed: This attempt counted as one scored submission.
failure.quotaNotConsumed: This attempt did not count as a scored submission.
failure.visibleToYou: Only you and the platform’s administrators can see this page.
failure.visibleToSubmitter: Only its submitter and the platform’s administrators can see this page.

pending.title: Waiting for the result
pending.body: This submission has been accepted and is not scored yet. Reload the page later.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Computed against the reference labels of <link>{task}</link>. They can be compared with other submissions to this task, and with no other task.

task.title: Task
task.threshold: <num>{threshold}</num> <muted>— a grade of {threshold} or more counts as referable.</muted>

perClass.title: Per-class results
perClass.description: How the file did on each class. Precision: of the items it gave this label, the share that have it. Recall: of the items that have this label, the share it found. F1 combines the two. Items is the number of scored items with this reference label.
perClass.notApplicable: Not applicable: no item of this class

method.title: Evaluation method
method.description: The scoring procedure that produced these numbers, and whether it has been reviewed.
method.notAttributedBody: Result from before method versions were recorded. It is not linked to a version of an evaluation method, so there is no review status to show and it is not part of published reporting.

modelCard.title: Model card
modelCard.description: The model this result is evidence for. A linked result is listed on that model’s card.
modelCard.status: {status, select, DRAFT {Draft, not reviewed yet} SUBMITTED {Submitted for review} PUBLISHED {Published} WITHDRAWN {Withdrawn} other {{status}}}
modelCard.noneShown: No model card is shown: none is linked, or the linked card is not published yet.

saved.unlinked: The link to the model card is removed.
saved.unchanged: Nothing changed: this is the card already linked.
